V.notes_en: Records source citations without verifying external rules; a planned ADR or release is not treated as a current rule.

B.value_en: Do not alter already landed TASK/REPORT/ISSUE instance files, change routing, duplicate REVIEW slugs, break legacy compatibility, or start before ADMIN kickoff; protocol code and rule documents receive the planned additive edits.
